Chosen Foods:

Olivado:

La Tourangelle:

BetterBody Foods:

Key Tips for Buying
Check for Purity:
Look for third-party purity seals or 100% single-source Hass avocado labels, as studies show some commercial oils get mixed with cheaper oils.
Select the Right Type:
Use cold-pressed or extra virgin for dressings and light sautéing; use refined avocado oil for high-heat frying or roasting.
